raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Disclosure

AI assistance was used. The changes were reviewed and tested manually.

## Overview

Support AMD Quark checkpoints whose routed experts are OCP MX MXFP8 (W8A8) instead of MXFP4/MXFP6, by adding a `QuarkW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod`.

This also makes per-layer mixed checkpoints (some MoE layers MXFP8, others MXFP4) loadable, since Quark already resolves the scheme per layer.

## Claims

- A Quark checkpoint with MXFP8 (W8A8) routed experts now loads and serves instead of failing at model construction with `ValueError: Unsupported OCP MX dtype combination for MoE: input_dtype=mxfp8_e4m3, weight_dtype=mxfp8_e4m3`.
- MXFP8 experts use the existing MXFP8 MoE stack (`select_mxfp8_moe_backend`, `convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format`, `make_fp8_moe_kernel`), i.e. `AITER_MXFP8` on gfx950, with dynamic MXFP8 activations — no new kernel, no new weight layout.
- Per-layer mixed MXFP4/MXFP8 routed experts work with no change to Quark's config resolution: `layer_quant_config` entries matching `<layer>.experts*` select MXFP8 for that layer, everything else falls back to `global_quant_config`.
- Unsupported spellings fail early with an actionable error: only the 1-D `per_group`/`group_size=32`/`e8m0` weight spelling is accepted for MXFP8 experts (the 2-D `per_block` spelling is Linear-only), and biases are rejected.
- No change for existing MXFP4/MXFP6/INT8/FP8/NVFP4 Quark checkpoints.

## Validation

New and affected tests in `tests/quantization/test_quark.py`, on MI350:

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  "tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quant_method_dispatch_target[ocp_mx_mxfp8_activation]" \
  "tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quant_method_dispatch_target[ocp_mx_mxfp8_per_block_experts]" \
  "tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quant_method_dispatch_instantiation[ocp_mx_mxfp8_activation]" \
  tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quant_method_dispatch_mixed_mxfp4_mxfp8_experts \
  tests/quantization/test_quark.py::test_quark_w8a8_mxfp8_moe_weight_shapes
```

```
5 passed, 14 warnings in 8.78s
```

The dispatch matrix these extend, which re-checks every pre-existing Quark scheme:

```bash
python -m pytest -q -k "dispatch_target or dispatch_instantiation" tests/quantization/test_quark.py
```

```
60 passed, 75 deselected, 14 warnings in 36.07s
```

- The `[ocp_mx_mxfp8_activation]` cases resolve W8A8 MXFP8 experts to `(kMxfp8Static, kMxfp8Dynamic, QuarkW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod)` and instantiate that method; `[ocp_mx_mxfp8_per_block_experts]` rejects the 2-D `per_block` spelling on experts.
- `test_quant_method_dispatch_mixed_mxfp4_mxfp8_experts` checks that a `<layer>.experts*` entry selects MXFP8 for that layer only, with other layers on the global MXFP4 and `shared_experts` unaffected.
- `test_quark_w8a8_mxfp8_moe_weight_shapes` checks the `[E, rows, cols]` E4M3 / `[E, rows, cols / 32]` uint8 parameter layout and the rejection of shapes not divisible by 32.

End-to-end accuracy of a Quark MXFP8 MoE checkpoint was not measured here; the numerics are those of the shared MXFP8 MoE path.

## Details

Quark resolves MoE schemes per layer (`global_quant_config` plus `layer_quant_config` globs), but `quark_moe.py` had no MXFP8 MoE method: `fp8_e4m3`/`per_group`/`group_size=32`/`e8m0` routed experts were dispatched to `QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod`, which only implements MXFP4/MXFP6, and failed at model construction.

`QuarkW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod` mirrors `CompressedTensorsW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod` (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/compressed_tensors/compressed_tensors_moe/compressed_tensors_moe_w8a8_mxfp8.py#L35).

Behavior changes:
- `QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod` no longer declares MXFP8 in its `supported_*_quant_keys`, so MXFP8 experts are rejected by the shared `QuarkMoEMethod` validation instead of the later `OCP_MX_Scheme` check (its `ValueError` keeps upstream's wording),
- Quark checkpoints that previously failed to load now serve

Limitations:
- `hidden_size`/`intermediate_size_per_partition` must be divisible by 32,
- no bias,
- dynamic MXFP8 activations only, and the kernel comes from `select_mxfp8_moe_backend` (`AITER_MXFP8` on gfx950)

No new flag, config field or env var, so no docs change.

No duplicate work: `gh pr list --repo vllm-project/vllm --state open --search "quark mxfp8"` and `--search "mxfp8 MoE quark in:body"` return no PR adding a Quark MXFP8 MoE method; #61457 (per-layer fused shared expert) and #56523 (MXFP4 oracle) are distinct.

+class QuarkW8A8Mxfp8MoEMethod(QuarkMoEMethod):
+    """Quark OCP MX MXFP8 (W8A8) experts.
+
+    FP8 E4M3 weights with E8M0 uint8 scales per 1x32 block (Quark ``fp8_e4m3``
+    ``per_group`` ``group_size=32`` ``scale_format=e8m0``), and activations
+    dynamically quantized to MXFP8. The stored layout is the one the online,
+    ModelOpt and compressed-tensors MXFP8 MoE methods produce or load
+    (``[E, rows, cols]`` E4M3, ``[E, rows, cols / 32]`` uint8), and the weights go
+    through the same backend selection, kernel-format conversion and kernel
+    (``AITER_MXFP8`` on gfx950).
+    """
+
+    supported_activation_quant_keys = [kMxfp8Dynamic]
+    supported_weight_quant_keys = [kMxfp8Static]
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        moe: FusedMoEConfig,
+        weight_quant_key: QuantKey,
+        activation_quant_key: QuantKey | None,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(moe, weight_quant_key, activation_quant_key)
+        if self.has_bias:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Quark MXFP8 MoE does not support biases.")
+        self.weight_block_size = [1, MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE]
+        self.mxfp8_backend, self.experts_cls = select_mxfp8_moe_backend(config=self.moe)
+        logger.info_once(
+            "Using %s backend for Quark MXFP8 (W8A8) MoE.", self.mxfp8_backend.value
+        )
+
+    def create_weights(
+        self,
+        layer: RoutedExperts,
+        num_experts: int,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        intermediate_size_per_partition: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        **extra_weight_attrs,
+    ):
+        if (
+            hidden_size % MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE != 0
+            or intermediate_size_per_partition % MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE != 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Quark MXFP8 MoE requires hidden_size and "
+                f"intermediate_size_per_partition divisible by {MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE}, "
+                f"got {hidden_size} and {intermediate_size_per_partition}."
+            )
+        layer.num_experts = num_experts
+        layer.orig_dtype = params_dtype
+        w13_rows = self.moe.w13_num_shards * intermediate_size_per_partition
+        # The scales are sharded with their weights along both dims (one scale
+        # per 32 input elements), like the OCP MX block scales.
+        extra_weight_attrs.update(
+            {"quant_method": FusedMoeWeightScaleSupported.BLOCK.value}
+        )
+        shapes = {
+            "w13_weight": ((num_experts, w13_rows, hidden_size), MXFP8_VALUE_DTYPE),
+            "w2_weight": (
+                (num_experts, hidden_size, intermediate_size_per_partition),
+                MXFP8_VALUE_DTYPE,
+            ),
+            "w13_weight_scale": (
+                (num_experts, w13_rows, hidden_size // MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE),
+                MXFP8_SCALE_DTYPE,
+            ),
+            "w2_weight_scale": (
+                (
+                    num_experts,
+                    hidden_size,
+                    intermediate_size_per_partition // MXFP8_BLOCK_SIZE,
+                ),
+                MXFP8_SCALE_DTYPE,
+            ),
+        }
+        for name, (shape, dtype) in shapes.items():
+            param = torch.nn.Parameter(
+                torch.empty(shape, dtype=dtype), requires_grad=False
+            )
+            layer.register_parameter(name, param)
+            set_weight_attrs(param, extra_weight_attrs)
+
+        layer.w13_input_scale = None
+        layer.w2_input_scale = None
+
+    def process_weights_after_loading(self, layer: RoutedExperts) -> None:
+        layer.weight_block_size = self.weight_block_size
+        w13, w2, w13_scale, w2_scale = convert_to_fp8_moe_kernel_format(
+            fp8_backend=self.mxfp8_backend,
+            layer=layer,
+            w13=layer.w13_weight,
+            w2=layer.w2_weight,
+            w13_scale=layer.w13_weight_scale,
+            w2_scale=layer.w2_weight_scale,
+            w13_input_scale=None,
+            w2_input_scale=None,
+        )
+        replace_parameter(layer, "w13_weight", w13)
+        replace_parameter(layer, "w2_weight", w2)
+        replace_parameter(layer, "w13_weight_scale", w13_scale)
+        replace_parameter(layer, "w2_weight_scale", w2_scale)
+
+        self.moe_quant_config = self.get_fused_moe_quant_config(layer)
+        assert self.moe_quant_config is not None
+        assert self.experts_cls is not None
+        self.moe_kernel = make_fp8_moe_kernel(
+            moe_quant_config=self.moe_quant_config,
+            moe_config=self.moe,
+            fp8_backend=self.mxfp8_backend,
+            experts_cls=self.experts_cls,
+            routing_tables=layer._expert_routing_tables(),
+        )
+
+    def get_fused_moe_quant_config(
+        self, layer: RoutedExperts
+    ) -> FusedMoEQuantConfig | None:
+        return make_fp8_moe_quant_config(
+            fp8_backend=self.mxfp8_backend,
+            w1_scale=layer.w13_weight_scale,
+            w2_scale=layer.w2_weight_scale,
+            a1_scale=None,
+            a2_scale=None,
+            block_shape=self.weight_block_size,
+            swiglu_limit=getattr(layer, "swiglu_limit", None),
+            gemm1_alpha=getattr(layer, "swiglu_alpha", None),
+            gemm1_beta=getattr(layer, "swiglu_beta", None),
+            layer=layer,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def supports_eplb(self) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    def apply(
+        self,
+        layer: RoutedExperts,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        shared_experts: SharedExperts | None,
+        shared_experts_input: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | UnfinalizedMoEOutput:
+        assert not self.is_monolithic
+        assert self.moe_kernel is not None
+        return self.moe_kernel.apply(
+            x,
+            layer.w13_weight,
+            layer.w2_weight,
+            topk_weights,
+            topk_ids,
+            activation=layer.activation,
+            global_num_experts=layer.global_num_experts,
+            expert_map=layer.expert_map,
+            apply_router_weight_on_input=layer.apply_router_weight_on_input,
+            shared_experts=shared_experts,
+            shared_experts_input=shared_experts_input,
+        )
+
+    def apply_monolithic(
+        self,
+        layer: RoutedExperts,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | UnfinalizedMoEOutput:
+        assert self.is_monolithic
+        assert self.moe_kernel is not None
+        return self.moe_kernel.apply_monolithic(
+            x,
+            layer.w13_weight,
+            layer.w2_weight,
+            router_logits,
+            activation=layer.activation,
+            global_num_experts=layer.global_num_experts,
+            expert_map=layer.expert_map,
+            apply_router_weight_on_input=layer.apply_router_weight_on_input,
+            num_expert_group=layer.num_expert_group,
+            topk_group=layer.topk_group,
+            e_score_correction_bias=layer.e_score_correction_bias,
+            routed_scaling_factor=layer.routed_scaling_factor,
+            routing_sink=layer.routing_sink,
+        )
+
+
 class QuarkNvfp4MoEMethod(QuarkMoEMethod):
     supported_activation_quant_keys = [kNvfp4Dynamic]
     supported_weight_quant_keys = [kNvfp4Static]
